notes.note: Murdock had just the 13 touches as he has gone from a player we want on the field to one we can only just rely on for bench cover as he hasn't been over 60 in the last four.
This is three in a row now in the 50s for Murdock which is a concern for owners looking to use him as F6. He is one that you should be looping off the bench where you can.

Murdock has really put the brakes on his scoring over the last two games with both being in the low 50s. He was playing as a defensive forward again this week which is really hurting his scores. Ideally you would be looping his scores where possible.

Murdock has been inconsistent in scoring of late as he had 16 disposals this week as he was playing as a defensive forward. He is still one to hold though. His BE is up at 61 but he should be one of our last upgrades.
Another week and we have seen a defensive role from Murdock. This time he was tasked with Roberts. He still managed to score well kicking 3 goals from his 19 disposals.
Murdock had jobs again this week with time spent with Josh Daicos and then Pendlebury but this time he was able to rack up 22 disposals and a goal. He posted his second best score of the season.
Murdock posted his lowest score for the year which was due to his change in role where he tagged Whitfield for the game.  He had just 1 point in the first term. Hopefully this was a one off.
Murdock had his best score since his debut game with 25 disposals this week and 7 contested. This has seen his BE dropping to 30
Just the 16 touches for Murdock as he hasn't recaptured the form he had before his injury. His BE has jumped to 41 and this may force us to make a decision soon.
Murdock had his lowest but it was a poor game from the Eagles. 20 disposals for him and his cash generation has been slowed but certainly not stopped.
We had been waiting for a few weeks for Murdock to return. His great BE remains after his 8 tackles and 19 disposals delivered another high score.
Murdock was one of the highest traded in players this week and he didn't let us down with 92 points but will now miss 1-2 weeks with a hamstring injury.
Murdock came in for his first game and he top scored for the Eagles! You don't have to get him in this week but he must be on your watch list for after his second game.
